objective: Re-run, at the FROZEN rev29 / schema-rev13 pins, the pre-registered machine evaluation of the three guards of transfer rule T1 (AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN -> AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN) against the canonical schemas. The prior measurement W071-T1-GUARD-EVAL-01 (worker-071, pins F2b 1bb78ce9b357, F2a b6123750b37d, F0 276009f4f63d, map 4fd40d4d1e4f) is void by its own falsifier because every schema input hash changed at the rev13 publication; no rev13 re-run exists. This is an independent clean-room instrument, not a replay of artifacts/worker-071/t1_guard_eval/eval_t1_guards.py. Measurement only: no gate verdict, no node status, no validation_status=passed.
why_this_task: The G-FORM gate record still lists the unmet item 'no single frozen data class (s,delta,norm) is shared by F1/F2a/F2b, which disables the licensed C0=>C2 transfer'. T1 guards are the licensing condition for the C0=>C2 direction. rev13 moved F1/F2a/F2b bytes, so the guard verdict must be re-measured before any r3 acceptance can rely on it.

t1_rule_verbatim.reason: If no C0 extension exists, then no C2 extension exists.
guards: data_class fields must match exactly (including s, delta once F2 fixes them)
genericity_kind and genericity_topology must match exactly
the source claim must carry artifact_refs and a reviewer verdict

F1_context.role: context only; F1 is a different transfer family, never part of T1

map_snapshot.role: G3 claim/review population; pinned because the map mutates on the 15-minute cycle

prior_instrument_reference.role: reference only; this run's evaluator is written independently from the pre-registered rules below and does not import or execute this file

core_keys_source: artifacts/worker-071/dataclass_alignment/method.json#core_keys_fixed_before_run (FORM-DC-ALIGN-071), reused unchanged so the rev12 and rev13 measurements are comparable

evaluation_rules_fixed_before_run.G1_literal_reading: PASS iff every leaf path under the F2b data_class subtree equals the same path under the F2a data_class subtree by exact value equality (scalars as parsed; lists/dicts structurally; no whitespace collapsing, no dropping of parenthetical or post-semicolon text). A path present on only one side is a witness. Witnesses are (path, F2a value, F2b value, F2a line, F2b line). Only F2a and F2b are compared for G1; F1 is out of scope for T1.
evaluation_rules_fixed_before_run.G1_secondary_reading: T3-normalized core reading: over the pre-registered core keys only, drop parenthesized fragments and text after the first ';', collapse whitespace, strip trailing punctuation, then compare. Reported for continuity with FORM-DC-ALIGN-071; never binding.
evaluation_rules_fixed_before_run.G2_literal_reading: Resolve the exact literal field names 'genericity_kind' and 'genericity_topology' as dotted key paths in each schema root. PASS iff both names resolve in both schemas and their values are equal; UNEVALUABLE_AS_WRITTEN if either name does not resolve in either schema (a missing field cannot match); FAIL iff both resolve and differ.
evaluation_rules_fixed_before_run.G2_secondary_reading: Mapped reading with genericity.kind and genericity.topology_or_measure. The mapping is inferred by the artifact and is NOT declared in F0; reported separately, never binding.
evaluation_rules_fixed_before_run.G3_literal_reading: Source claims = claims in the pinned map snapshot whose class_id or class_ids includes AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN. PASS iff at least one such claim has non-empty artifact_refs AND at least one review in the same map snapshot has target_id equal to that claim's event_id with verdict in {accept, revise, reject, inconclusive}. FAIL otherwise. Population sizes reported.
evaluation_rules_fixed_before_run.G3_strengthened_diagnostic: Not pre-registered as binding in W071 and not binding here either: a source claim qualifies only if it asserts C0 future-inextendibility, defined as the pre-registered regex \bc0\b (case-insensitive) co-occurring with 'inextendib' (case-insensitive) in its statement or conclusion text fields, has non-empty artifact_refs, and has an accept verdict review targeting it. Reported as a diagnostic only.
evaluation_rules_fixed_before_run.F1_context_reading: For context only: strict leaf witnesses between the F1 data_class and the F2b data_class, flagged by core-key membership. F1 is not part of T1 and this reading never enters the T1 decision.
evaluation_rules_fixed_before_run.overall_decision: T1_licensed_at_pins = (G1_literal PASS) AND (G2_literal PASS) AND (G3_literal PASS). UNEVALUABLE_AS_WRITTEN at any guard counts as NOT PASS and is reported as a distinct blocked state. Secondary readings never change the binding decision.
evaluation_rules_fixed_before_run.measurement_validity: A measurement is valid iff window_status == STABLE (every pinned input re-hashes to its snapshot value after the run) and all controls pass. A VOID window voids the result at the changed path, not the other paths' findings.

controls_fixed_before_run.CTL_POS_G1: F2b data_class compared against itself must evaluate PASS under G1 strict.
controls_fixed_before_run.CTL_NEG_G1: Two synthetic copies of the F2a data_class differing only at asymptotic_decay.parity_conditions must evaluate FAIL with exactly that witness path.
controls_fixed_before_run.CTL_POS_G2: Two synthetic documents carrying genericity_kind and genericity_topology with equal values must evaluate PASS under literal G2.
controls_fixed_before_run.CTL_NEG_G2: Two synthetic documents carrying genericity_kind and genericity_topology with one unequal value must evaluate FAIL under literal G2.
controls_fixed_before_run.CTL_POS_G3: A synthetic claim with non-empty artifact_refs plus a synthetic review targeting it must evaluate PASS under the G3 rule.
controls_fixed_before_run.CTL_NEG_G3: A synthetic claim with non-empty artifact_refs and no review must evaluate FAIL under the G3 rule.
controls_fixed_before_run.CTL_SELFEQ_G1: F2a data_class compared against itself must evaluate PASS under G1 strict.
controls_fixed_before_run.CTL_MISSING_KEY_G1: A synthetic pair where one side lacks a core key must report that key as a witness, not crash and not silently pass.
controls_fixed_before_run.hash_stability: All pinned inputs are hashed before and after the evaluation; any change sets window_status=VOID at the changed path and the run exits 2.

expected_if_rev13_repair_is_semantically: G1 literal still FAIL (the annotation-only adm_mass paths identified at rev12); G1 secondary core reading PASS; G2 literal still UNEVALUABLE_AS_WRITTEN (field-name defect untouched by the evidence-binding card); G3 literal evaluated on the current map snapshot; overall T1_licensed_at_pins False unless a guard unexpectedly passes.
falsifier: This measurement is falsified if a re-run of the independent evaluator at these pins returns different per-guard verdicts or a different witness set; if any input sha256 drifts across the window (the run is VOID at the changed path); if any control stops discriminating; or if a guard evaluates PASS contrary to the recorded verdict (in particular, all three PASS would license T1 at these pins and refute the G-FORM unmet item at the full strength of the transfer rule). Any input sha256 change voids the measurement at the changed path and requires a re-run at the new pins.
limitations: G1 compares F2b (source) with F2a (target) only; F1 (AF-WCC-VAC-GEN) belongs to a different transfer family and is context only.
The G2 mapped reading uses a mapping inferred by the artifact; F0 does not declare it.
G3 binds claims/reviews present in the pinned map snapshot only; un-ingested outbox traffic and events applied after the snapshot are out of scope.
The strengthened G3 diagnostic is an explicitly non-binding convenience reading.
Line numbers are value-node start lines from the YAML composer.
No gate verdict, no node status, no validation_status=passed is asserted.
authority_note: Worker output only. Canonical paths are authoritative. The lead-formulation owns the schemas; the controller and group leads own gate verdicts and node status.
